_comment: The ship-blocking gate for a drugs tier. Every item is ORDINARY traffic
that contains drug vocabulary, medical vocabulary, or the shape of a
transaction — and none of it is dealing.
Drug slang is the worst vocabulary in the whole taxonomy for collisions:
Molly and Charlie are names, ice and snow are weather, weed and grass are
gardening, coke is a drink, pot is cookware, a gram is a unit, and a
'dealer' sells cars. A tier that fires on words alone will accuse someone
of dealing because they weeded the garden and asked what they owe.
That is why the tier requires SUBSTANCE + TRANSACTION shape together —
the same lesson the scam tier learned when its classifier flagged 21 of 25
bank and delivery messages. These items exist to prove the conjunction is
doing real work: many carry one half and must still stay silent.
Hand-written (single author — the known limitation), so this is a
BEHAVIOURAL gate, never a headline number.
